evidence.reason: render_units recursively collects CRQ templates but flattens them to source.name when writing output/source.name. If two templates with the same basename exist under different subdirectories, the later atomic_bytes overwrites the earlier one, and the returned paths contain the same target twice. This is a real data-loss/collision bug in the current implementation, not a new policy requirement. The smallest fix is to reject duplicate basenames with a ValueError before output.mkdir or before any unit is written.
